operations.title: The Entry 653 top projection proves occupancy only for the rank-twenty-one three-pole subpacket
operations.statement: The complete physical q_G12 source consists of two rank-thirty-five five-pole families with q_g3 and an occurrence wall. Entry 653's verified three-pole calculation is a deletion-face result, not a complete-source occupancy theorem.

authority_basis.summary: Entry 656 corrects my overbroad interpretation of Entry 653 while preserving its verified three-pole linear algebra.
